Revision 4 remains unapprovable. Preserve all accepted requirements, complete Browser acquisition, the actual operations, at most ten sequential product visits, explicit consent handling/reobservation, workbook writing/path and unconditional cleanup. Make only the following implementation corrections; no new business work or permissions.

1. each.input names an existing bound input, not a newly declared item variable. Correct extract_home_pages and extract_after_cookie_pages to input homePages, extract_search_pages to searchPages, extract_product_pages to productPages. Keep their sole nonnullable array result fields. Every original bounded page and record must be processed, preserving order, nesting, duplicates and source references.

2. The four check_*_snapshot_complete tasks currently send complete raw snapshots to interpret to invent isComplete. This is forbidden for this review: use existing value/predicate bindings and boolean requires against the authoritative success/truncated/captureTruncated/manifestTruncated values and presence of observationSnapshot. No LLM may decide completeness. Keep URL/title as direct observed fields. If incomplete, stop explicitly before extraction/write and retain cleanup. Do not publish a successful replacement workbook or blocker product row for incomplete acquisition. Keep any downstream references compatible with the corrected explicit output ports.

3. Extract-mode results may only contain actual observed values. Remove invented recordOrder numbers, observationStatus labels, and mandatory inferred listing fields from compact extraction schemas. Ordering is already preserved structurally. Preserve original nullable role/href (or omit them if not needed); missing values cannot become strings. Keep exact text, group and action references only where the corresponding consumer needs them. Global classification/status/ten-product selection remain interpret over these compact observed candidates only, not raw snapshot envelopes. Product values must come from the product page, never a listing substitution.

Do not relax guards, invent schema fields, drop write/cleanup operations, add inputs, silently broaden scopes or increase limits. Return the full corrected plan with unchanged requirements.
